from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    singles = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if seen[r][c]:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen[r][c] = True
            comp = []
            for y, x in q:
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            if len(comp) == 1:
                singles.append(comp[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    global_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    for r, c in singles:
        around8 = [grid[y][x] for y in range(max(0,r-1), min(h,r+2))
                   for x in range(max(0,c-1), min(w,c+2)) if (y,x) != (r,c)]
        counts = Counter(v for v in around8 if v != grid[r][c])
        if not counts:
            continue
        top = max(counts.values())
        candidates = [v for v,n in counts.items() if n == top]
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            around4 = [grid[y][x] for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))
                       if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and grid[y][x] != grid[r][c]]
            c4 = Counter(around4)
            best4 = max((c4[v] for v in candidates), default=0)
            narrowed = [v for v in candidates if c4[v] == best4]
            if len(narrowed) == 1:
                candidates = narrowed
            else:
                candidates = narrowed
        out[r][c] = max(candidates, key=lambda v: global_counts[v])
    return out
